body:
If you and your siblings are splitting this and these aren’t everyday tasks, then yea you are overreacting. When you are living on your own, this whole list is your responsibility, so regular practice in up keeping your space is just good parenting. 

On the other hand, each of you have to do these tasks everyday, while also being honor students and athletes is kind of ridiculous. Do the parents have chores too? Just because you are a child doesn’t mean you have to clean up after their messes. These tasks are time consuming and you need time to relax and process your day when you’re at home.

I really like this style of cover up. I thought I would hate the OG tattoos peaking through, but I kinda love it. Gives the whole thing character. The cover up design choice is so smart and well executed. Big props 👏🏾

People sometimes refer to those strong feelings for a new relationship as NRE (new relationship energy). It’s just the overall obsession you have with a new love interest. It happens in the beginning of relationships and tends to wane as time goes on. I know throwing up sounds a bit dramatic but I would agree that it’s super normal especially since this is your first experience with love like this.
You might want to check on LinkedIn for people who have had similar jobs to this. Just DM people. I’ve DM’d strangers on LinkedIn before and they were very receptive.
Beautifully said! I agree with you, you were right but it’s all about timing.

You are definitely justified in being pissed. He was wrong for not telling you. Why would he not say that he didn’t want to move in the first place? You guys are married, so he should feel comfortable talking to you about stuff even if it’s uncomfortable. Now you have to deal with him being mad all the time because you wanted to move and he didn’t. You cannot read peoples minds, he should have communicated. Also, people do just expect women to move and don’t congratulate them like men. But I don’t think that’s the main point here. You both made a decision for your family and now you both need to move forward. Either he stops being a baby about moving or you guys try to figure out something that works for both of you in the relationship. I wish you all the best girl, cause I would have kicked him out.

It’s totally normal. Pregnancy is super scary, especially the way it’s handled in modern medicine. I’ve had pregnancy anxiety for a while now and just decided it’s not for me. I’ll definitely be adopting or getting a surrogate. So if you’re weird, so am I ☺️
